name: soase-validator
description: Validation, completion, hover help and go-to-definition for Sins of a Solar Empire mod files, powered by the soase-validator language server.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The Server is not started in an untrusted workspace, because the Server Command and settings name executables and file paths.

soase-validator.gameVersion.description: Game Version id: vanilla, entrenchment, diplomacy, rebellion-185, rebellion-193, rebellion-194 or rebellion-1.98. A project `soase.json` and the Server's environment variables take precedence over this value. See the configuration section of the soase-validator README.

soase-validator.referenceRoots.description: Object from Game Version id to the base game data directory, for example {"rebellion-1.98": "~/path/to/sins-rebellion-reference"}. A project `soase.json` and the Server's environment variables take precedence over this value. See the configuration section of the soase-validator README.

soase-validator.modRoots.description: Mod Root directories, for example ["~/path/to/my-mod"]. A project `soase.json` and the Server's environment variables take precedence over this value. See the configuration section of the soase-validator README.

soase-validator.layers.description: Parent Layers, lowest first: directory paths or @alias entries, for example ["~/path/to/parent-mod"]. A project `soase.json` and the Server's environment variables take precedence over this value. See the configuration section of the soase-validator README.

soase-validator.language.description: Localization folder name, such as en. A project `soase.json` and the Server's environment variables take precedence over this value. See the configuration section of the soase-validator README.

soase-validator.disabledCodes.description: Diagnostic codes to hide, such as SOASE-C030. A project `soase.json` and the Server's environment variables take precedence over this value. See the configuration section of the soase-validator README.

soase-validator.numeric.integerStrict.description: Reject integers written with a decimal point. A project `soase.json` and the Server's environment variables take precedence over this value. See the configuration section of the soase-validator README.

soase-validator.numeric.decimalAllowInte.description: Accept integers where decimals are expected. A project `soase.json` and the Server's environment variables take precedence over this value. See the configuration section of the soase-validator README.

soase-validator.manifest.unreferencedSev.description: Severity of SOASE-M020: error, warning or info. A project `soase.json` and the Server's environment variables take precedence over this value. See the configuration section of the soase-validator README.

soase-validator.manifest.exemptUnlisted.description: Patterns exempt from SOASE-M010. A project `soase.json` and the Server's environment variables take precedence over this value. See the configuration section of the soase-validator README.

soase-validator.manifest.exemptUnreferen.description: Patterns exempt from SOASE-M020. A project `soase.json` and the Server's environment variables take precedence over this value. See the configuration section of the soase-validator README.

soase-validator.reportOverrides.description: Report Project files that override a lower Layer (SOASE-C040). A project `soase.json` and the Server's environment variables take precedence over this value. See the configuration section of the soase-validator README.

soase-validator.suppressLimitedReference.description: Hide SOASE-C030. A project `soase.json` and the Server's environment variables take precedence over this value. See the configuration section of the soase-validator README.

soase-validator.uvPath.description: Path to the uvx executable, for example ~/path/to/uvx. Leave empty to search PATH and the standard uv install locations. A leading ~ and environment variables are expanded.

soase-validator.serverSource.description: Package source passed to uvx --from, for example a path such as ~/path/to/soase-validator or a git URL. Leave empty to use the default GitHub source.

soase-validator.startupTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the Server to answer the initialize request before reporting a startup failure. The first start can take long while uvx downloads packages.

soase-validator.trace.server.description: Traces the messages between VS Code and the Server in the SoaSE Validator output channel.

scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run test:unit && npm run test:host
